prompt: Using the neo4j-cli command, find out which stored database (DBMS) credentials exist and tell me the name of the stored credential. Use the CLI itself to discover how, not the internet.
Using neo4j-cli, set the global default output format to json and confirm the change took effect.
Run `neo4j-cli --format nope config list`. It will fail. Fix the command using only the information in the error message, and run it successfully. Tell me the command that worked.
Install the neo4j-cli agent skill for Claude Code only (not other agents) and tell me which skill files were installed.
Using neo4j-cli's own discovery output (not source code or the internet), list the `aura instance` subcommands that change state, so they need --rw. Reply with the subcommand names only.
Show the 5 most recent neo4j-cli command history entries, newest first, as a JSON array of the command strings only. Reply with the JSON array and nothing else.
Using neo4j-cli, start a throwaway local Neo4j in Docker (community edition), run the Cypher `RETURN 1+41 AS answer` against it, and tell me the answer. Remove the container when done.
Using neo4j-cli, find out what the Aura project in my default workspace is called. Reply with the project name only. Use the CLI itself to discover how, not the internet.
Using neo4j-cli, create a free Aura instance named bench-t9-{run} in my default workspace, wait until it is running, and tell me its instance ID. Do not store or show its password.
Using neo4j-cli, delete the Aura instance named bench-t10-{run} in my default workspace, and tell me its instance ID.
